note: Superior National Forest campground on the South Kawishiwi River about 10 miles south-east of Ely on Highway 1; the river north of the campground is in the Boundary Waters (permit needed, no motors). Wooded loops with a grassy swimming beach, boat ramp, the 1-mile Kawishiwi River Forest Trail and a CCC-built log pavilion; canoe rentals through the host. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + FS page read: 31 back-in sites, 23 electric (three 50-amp at $32), 40-88 ft; $22 / $30 / $32 (was 22/30); 21 reservable, 10 first-come; season early May to Sep 26; vault toilets, water. Not waterfront kept (river 40-60 m from the north sites through forest). Pin ~240 m from the site centroid, near site 001 (OK).
flags: Sites: max_rig_ft 52 (derived) -> 88 (rec.gov catalog; site 025's 107 ft looks like a typo and is not used). The Forest Service page's 'Spur lengths range from 35 ft long by 13 ft wide to 52 ft long' and '14 campsites have electricity' are older than the catalog (40-88 ft; 23 sites with amps). Every site permits RV/Trailer/Tent; shortest 40 ft (site 027) - a 23-ft rig fits everywhere.
Booking: fcfs some_sites added - sites 013, 015, 016, 017, 018, 019, 020, 021, 024, 025 are typed not reservable on recreation.gov.
Waterfront: keep not waterfront. The north sites 026, 027, 029 are ~40-60 m from the river through continuous forest on imagery; the catalog gives no 'Proximity to Water'.
Pin 47.81556,-91.73165 is ~70 m from site 001 by the entrance and ~240 m from the site centroid (47.81702,-91.72932): OK.
